response_text:
(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a forward section constructed from an open rib structure; and an aero cover carried on said body panel and spanning said open rib structure, wherein said body panel further includes a first corner buttress and a second corner buttress.

(Currently Amended) Claim 15: A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a first corner buttress, a second corner buttress, a first open rib structure reinforcing said first corner buttress and a second open rib structure reinforcing said second corner buttress; a first aero cover spanning and closing said first open rib structure; and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second open rib structure, wherein said body panel further includes a plurality of closed ribs.
